SharedWorkspace.title: SharedWorkspace
SharedWorkspace.description: Stores the shared church worship ministry state (Louvor IEB Horta) visible and editable by all team members across devices.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the authenticated user or 'membro-ieb-horta' for direct team access.

playlistTitle.description: Title of the current Culto do Dia setlist.

playlistSongIds.description: Ordered list of song IDs in the current setlist (bounded to 100).

playlistTranspose.description: Map of songId to transpose semitone offset for the active setlist.

repertoireTranspose.description: Map of songId to transpose semitone offset in the general repertoire.

deletedSongIds.description: List of catalog song IDs removed from the shared repertoire (bounded to 500).

upsertedSongs.description: Map of songId to custom or edited Song objects (bounded to 200).

scheduleRoles.description: Ordered list of worship schedule role definitions (bounded to 30).

scheduleMembers.description: List of worship team member names (bounded to 100).

scheduleEntries.description: List of worship schedule rows/dates and role assignments (bounded to 200).

randomCount.description: Configured number of songs for random setlist generation (1 to 50).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the shared workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the shared workspace was last updated.

/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Shared church ministry workspace ('ieb_horta_main') storing setlist, worship schedule, transpose maps, deleted song IDs, and custom/edited songs for all users.
